jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value:
Europas industrielle Basis arbeitet in Zeiträumen von Monaten. Erfahrungswissen geht mit der Rente verloren, Lieferketten sind fragil. SAEKI baut das Betriebssystem für autonome Fabriken — die Infrastruktur, mit der einsatzkritische Bauteile für Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt in Software-Geschwindigkeit gefertigt werden.

Unsere neue Produktionsstätte im Osten des Großraums München ist der Ort, an dem das real wird: 5.000 m² Produktionsfläche, 5-Achs-Bearbeitungszentren, Industrieroboter und großformatige 3D-Drucker. Wir bauen die Serienfertigung gerade auf — du kommst zu einem Zeitpunkt, an dem deine Handschrift auf den Prozessen bleibt.

Du bist das produktionstechnische Rückgrat dieser Fabrik. Sobald unsere Prozessentwickler herausgefunden haben, wie ein Bauteil gefertigt wird, sorgst du dafür, dass es in Serie läuft — enge Toleranzen, Teil für Teil, in Fertigungszellen, die handwerkliches Können mit robotergestützter Automatisierung verbinden.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
• Du betreibst und optimierst du unsere Flotte von 5-Achs-Bearbeitungszentren in der Serienfertigung. Du arbeitest mit etablierten CAM-Programmen und Rüstdokumentationen, um Bauteile in Luftfahrtqualität in hohen Stückzahlen zu produzieren.

  • Du überwachst den Zerspanprozess, erkennst Abweichungen früh und korrigierst Vorschub, Drehzahl oder Werkzeug. Wenn ein Programm angepasst werden muss, eskalierst du sauber, statt Workarounds zu bauen.

  • Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit robotergestützten Beladesystemen und automatisierten Abläufen.

  • Du gibst dem Prozess- und Automatisierungsteam Rückmeldung darüber, was tatsächlich an der Spindel passiert. Maschinendaten fließen bei uns in Echtzeit in KI-Systeme — dein Urteil ist das, was diese Systeme besser macht.

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Betrieb von Mehrachs-CNC-Bearbeitungszentren, idealerweise 5-Achs. Du hast Serienfertigung gemacht — nicht nur Einzelteile.
  • Rüstkompetenz: Du kannst Maschinen eigenständig nach dokumentierten Prozessblättern einrichten — Werkzeuge einmessen, Werkstücknullpunkte setzen, Programme verifizieren und Erstmusterteile fahren, um zu bestätigen, dass das Setup sitzt.
  • Produktionsdisziplin: Erfahrung mit Serienaufträgen in engen Toleranzen und gleichbleibender Qualität. 
  • Werkstoffkenntnis: Erfahrung in der Zerspanung von Luftfahrtmetallen — Aluminium, Titan, Inconel oder Edelstahl. Du verstehst, wie sich Werkstoffe unter dem Werkzeug verhalten, und erkennst Probleme, bevor Ausschuss entsteht.
  • Zeichnungslesen: Du liest und interpretierst technische Zeichnungen inklusive Form- und Lagetoleranzen (GD&T) souverän. Du weißt, was die Toleranzen bedeuten und wie man sie misst.
  • Messtechnik: Sicherer Umgang mit Präzisionsmessmitteln — Mikrometer, Messschieber, Höhenmessgeräte.
  • Problemlösungskompetenz: Wenn ein Werkzeug rattert, ein Maß wegläuft oder die Oberfläche nicht passt, diagnostizierst und behebst du das — Vorschub, Drehzahl oder Werkzeug werden entsprechend angepasst. Du eskalierst klar, wenn etwas neu programmiert werden muss, statt Workarounds zu basteln.
  • Automatisierungsaffinität: Du arbeitest mit robotergestützten Beladesystemen und softwaregetriebenen Abläufen. 
  • Standort: Basis im Großraum München (Osten).
  • Sprache: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch.

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit SPC und prozessbegleitender Prüfung
  • Grundkenntnisse in der KMG-Bedienung
  • Erfahrung mit automatisierter Be- und Entladung (Roboterzellen, Palettensysteme)
  • Erfahrung in Luftfahrt-, Raumfahrt- oder Medizintechnikfertigung
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• Wer nur einlegen und Zyklusstart drücken will. Wir brauchen Zerspaner, die bei jedem Setup mitdenken.
  • Wer mit Robotern, Software und Datenerfassung in der Werkstatt fremdelt. Das ist bei uns Alltag, nicht Zukunftsmusik.
  • Wer sein Wissen lieber für sich behält. Deine Beobachtungen an der Maschine fließen direkt in die Systeme, die wir bauen.

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Die industrielle Souveränität des Westens wiederaufbauen. Deine Arbeit ermöglicht direkt die Fertigung einsatzkritischer Hardware für Verteidigung und Raumfahrt.
  • Die Umgebung: Zugang zu einer 5.000 m² großen, hochmodernen Produktionsstätte mit 5-Achs-CNC-Maschinen, Industrierobotern und großformatigen 3D-Druckern. Deine Arbeit läuft vom ersten Tag an auf echter Hardware.
  • Anstellung: Vollzeit, unbefristet. Aktuell reiner Tagbetrieb — kein Schichtmodell.
  • Das Team: Kleines Senior-Team, kurze Wege, direkte Entscheidungen. Kein Konzern, keine Politik — aber auch niemand, der dir hinterherräumt.
  • Vergütung: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt + substantielle Unternehmensanteile.
  • Standort: Großraum München (Osten). Ca. 20min mit der S-Bahn vom Münchner Ostbahnhof. Mit dem Auto gut erreichbar inkl. persönlichem Parkplatz.

jobDescription.name: Apply
jobDescription.value:
• Lebenslauf: Zeig uns, was du zerspant hast.
  • Anschreiben: Warum diese Mission? Warum jetzt?

jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value:
Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories, the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.
You'll own the physical buildout of SAEKI's factories, from empty floor space to fully operational, highly automated production lines. You are the person who turns a factory layout on a screen into a running facility.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
As the Factory Deployment Lead, you are the architect and program manager of our physical factory infrastructure. Your mandate is to plan, build out, and commission Factory ONE in Germany and then package that playbook so it can be replicated globally. You own the full deployment lifecycle: factory layout and material flow design, equipment selection and procurement, utility and infrastructure planning, installation supervision, automation integration, and ramp-up to series production.
You work backwards from production targets and forwards from a bare concrete slab, orchestrating every trade, vendor, and installation sequence required to stand up a world-class autonomous manufacturing facility on time and on budget.
Based on-site at Factory ONE in Munich, with travel to equipment vendors and future factory sites as needed.

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• 7+ years of experience in factory planning, industrial engineering, or manufacturing facility buildout ideally in automotive, aerospace, or high-volume precision manufacturing. You have personally led or been deeply embedded in at least one greenfield factory deployment or major production line installation.
  • Factory Layout and Material Flow Mastery: You think in terms of value streams, takt times, and material flow. You can design a factory layout that optimizes for throughput, flexibility, and automation - and you know how to iterate it as requirements change.
  • Equipment Integration: Hands-on experience specifying, procuring, installing, and commissioning capital equipment - CNC machines, industrial robots, conveyor systems, 3D printers, or similar. You understand foundations, utilities (power, compressed air, cooling), and the mechanical/electrical interfaces required to bring machines online.
  • Automation Deployment: Deep understanding of how to deploy and integrate automated production systems - robotic workcells, automated material handling, vision systems, and PLC-controlled infrastructure. You don't need to write PLC code, but you must understand how automated systems fit together at a systems level.
  • Program Management Rigor: You manage complex, multi-vendor buildout schedules with dozens of parallel workstreams. You are relentless about timelines, dependencies, and risk mitigation.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Experience managing relationships with machine tool OEMs, system integrators, construction contractors, and utility providers. You know how to hold vendors accountable and negotiate effectively.
  • Lean / Industrial Engineering Foundations: Strong grounding in lean manufacturing principles, line balancing, ergonomics, and continuous improvement. You design factories that are efficient from day one, not just functional.
  • Software-Driven Mindset: You are energized by the idea of a software-defined factory. You understand that the physical layout must be designed hand-in-hand with the digital infrastructure - sensors, networking, edge compute, and data collection are first-class citizens in your factory plans.
  • Location: Based in Munich (on-site at Factory ONE). Travel to vendor sites and future factory locations required.
  • Language: Fluent in German and English.

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• Traditional plant managers who optimize steady-state operations. This role is about building factories, not running them.
  • People who plan on paper but don't supervise execution. You will be on the floor during installation, commissioning, and ramp-up - hard hat and steel toes.
  • Engineers who treat automation and IT infrastructure as an afterthought to be "added later." At SAEKI, digital and physical infrastructure are designed together from the start.
  • Executives who need a large support team before they can be effective. You will start lean and build the team as the deployment scales.
  • People who are uncomfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration. Factory plans will change as our technology evolves - you must be able to adapt without losing momentum.

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 10,000m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your work runs on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Factory ONE in Munich

jobDescription.name: Apply
jobDescription.value:
• Resume: Focus on systems you've built and owned.
  • GitHub/Portfolio: Show us work you're proud of - code, machines, or production systems.
  • Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value:
Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.
You'll be the person who keeps SAEKI running while it scales. When the company doubles in size, enters a new market, or closes a financing round - you are in the middle of all of it, making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
As Founders Associate, you work directly with the Chief of Staff and CEO on everything it takes to run and scale a fast-growing deep tech company. Your day might start with onboarding a new hire, continue with preparing materials for a board meeting, and end with coordinating a shipment to Factory ONE in Munich. There is no "typical day" - and that's the point.

You are the operational backbone. HR, accounting, logistics, office management, compliance, vendor coordination - you own the day-to-day so the rest of the team can focus on building. But this isn't just an admin role. You'll also contribute to strategic workstreams - financing rounds, expansion planning, partnerships - executing on direction from leadership and growing into more ownership over time.

You are resourceful, fast, and unfazed by ambiguity. When something needs to happen and nobody owns it yet, you raise your hand.

Based at Factory ONE in Munich.

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• Previous Experience: You've gained initial work experience in a fast-paced environment (up to 3 years) - startup, management consulting, venture capital, investment banking, or similar. You've operated in a setting where you wore multiple hats and nothing was beneath you.
  • Operational Grit: You get things done. You don't wait for process - you build it. You can context-switch between booking a flight, reconciling an invoice, and drafting a board slide without losing focus or quality.
  • Strategic Horsepower: You can structure a problem, build a spreadsheet to analyze it, and present a recommendation. You're not just executing tasks - you understand why they matter and how they connect to the bigger picture.
  • Ownership Mentality: You don't need to be told what to do twice. When you spot a gap, you fill it. When something breaks, you fix it first and report it second.
  • People Skills: You'll interact with everyone - new hires, investors, accountants, lawyers, factory staff, suppliers. You are professional, warm, and effective across all of them.
  • Language: Fluent in German and English.

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• People who need a job description to know what to do. This role changes every month as the company grows. If you need a fixed scope and clear boundaries, this isn't the right fit.
  • Pure analysts who don't like getting their hands dirty. You will be filing paperwork, coordinating movers, setting up accounts, and chasing invoices - alongside more strategic work. Both matter equally.
  • People who optimize for their own learning over company output. Yes, you'll learn an enormous amount. But the priority is shipping - not personal development plans.
  • Candidates who need heavy management. You report to the Chief of Staff and CEO, both of whom move fast and expect you to keep up with minimal hand-holding.

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • Accelerated Growth: You'll work directly with the CEO and Chief of Staff across every function - finance, HR, legal, strategy, logistics. In two years you'll have seen more of how a company works than most people see in ten. Where you go from here - Head of Operations, Chief of Staff, launch a new business unit - depends on you.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Factory ONE in Munich, on-site

jobDescription.name: Apply
jobDescription.value:
• Resume: Focus on what you've built, shipped, or fixed - not just where you've worked.
  • Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? Tell us about a time you owned something messy and made it work.

jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value:
SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival.

You run your own projects end to end while we scale Factory ONE: preparing a financing round, building a process that does not exist yet, opening a new market or partnership. You work directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff, own the outcome of your workstreams and are trusted to make decisions, not just work through a to-do list.

You build the company that builds the factories.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
Operations. You own workstreams across HR, finance, logistics and compliance: running onboarding for new hires, setting up processes in our ERP, managing suppliers and the logistics that move equipment into Factory ONE.
Strategic projects. You drive pieces around financing, expansion planning and partnerships: building the models, preparing materials, assessing markets and grants. You start with clearly scoped projects and take on bigger ones as you prove yourself.
Process building. Where no process exists, you build one. You document how things work so the next hire can run it without you.
Gap-filling. You spot the tasks nobody owns and pick them up. You fix the problem first, then report it.

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• Student or recent graduate in business, economics, engineering or a related field, available for 6 months full-time. First experience in a startup, consulting, VC or banking (internship, working student job, student consulting club) is a plus.
  • Operational grit. You switch between a supplier negotiation, an ERP setup and a building a deck without dropping quality, and you set up structure where there is none.
  • Structured thinking. You break a problem down, analyze it and present a clear recommendation that connects to the bigger picture.
  • Ownership. You do not need to be told twice. You see a problem, you fix it, then you tell us.
  • People skills. You are professional and warm with new hires, investors, accountants, lawyers, colleagues and suppliers alike.
  • Language: Fluent German and English. You work with German authorities, landlords and suppliers in Munich and with the team in Zurich.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany.
  • Start date: asap

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• People who need a fixed job description. This role changes month to month.
  • Pure analysts who avoid hands-on work like filing, coordinating movers, setting up accounts and chasing invoices.
  • People who need heavy hand-holding. You will get direct feedback and support, but you are expected to figure things out.
  • People who need fixed priorities. Ours move as fast as the factory grows.

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Eliminate the industrial bottlenecks that limit human progress. You help build the company that produces defense and space hardware for the free world.
  • The Work: Real ownership from week one across finance, HR, legal, strategy and logistics, not a side project. Strong interns get the chance to grow into a full-time role.
  • The Team: You work daily with the CEO and Chief of Staff and report to the Chief of Staff. A small team where everyone ships, with direct feedback, high standards and minimal bureaucracy.
  • Compensation: Standard internship salary.

jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value: SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
As an Industrial Engineering Intern, you own the facility-specific work that decides how fast Factory ONE scales: where a workbench goes, which label survives the process temperatures, how an assembly is documented, which terminal goes where. You spend your days on the shop floor next to production staff, and you are the link between the people who run the factory and the Manufacturing Intelligence team that builds its software.

You turn a long list of one-off tasks into a factory that runs better every week.

Continuous improvement. Design layouts, improve material flow and 5S, source suppliers for parts like temperature-resilient labels, and write the SOPs for workbench assembly.
Software rollout on the floor. Deploy terminals across the factory, run inventory audits so stock can be tracked, onboard production staff to our tools, and collect bugs and requests for the software team.
Kaizen team. Set up and run a kaizen team in Factory ONE: a regular cadence to collect feedback from production staff, turned into a prioritized list of improvements that actually get done.
Documentation and handover. Write down every layout, supplier decision and SOP so it keeps working after your six months, and hand over open items cleanly.

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• Student (enrolled or recently graduated) in mechanical, industrial, manufacturing or a similar engineering program (Bachelor's or Master's), available full-time for six months.
  • Hands-on. You are comfortable on a factory floor and would rather fix the workbench than write a slide about it.
  • Structured and self-driven. You can take a long list of small tasks, rank them by impact and finish them without someone checking in.
  • Technical aptitude. You troubleshoot problems with limited guidance. No software background needed.
  • Talks to the floor. You ask production staff what is not working and listen to the answer.
  • Clear writing. Your SOPs and handover docs can be followed by someone who was not in the room.
  • Bonus: Lean, kaizen, 5S or workplace layout experience; supplier research or sourcing; basic CAD or spreadsheet skills.
  • Language: Working English for the team; good German for the shop floor is a strong plus.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany.

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• Someone who sees this as a stepping stone to a software or strategy job. This is a hands-on role with plenty of unglamorous work.
  • People who propose fixes before they have asked the operators what is going on.
  • Someone who needs a ticket for every task. You find the next problem yourself.
  • People who need fixed priorities. Ours move as fast as the factory grows.

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Eliminate the industrial bottlenecks that limit human progress. You remove the manual work that slows down the scale-up of our reference factory.
  • The Work: Real ownership of improvements in a greenfield factory with CNC, SLS and metal AM, and visible impact within six months. What you build becomes the standard for every factory we add.
  • The Team: Embedded in Manufacturing Intelligence, working daily with our Product Manager and the production leads, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence. Small team, no bureaucracy.
  • Duration: 6 months, full-time. Start date asap.
  • Compensation: Standard internship compensation.
  • Location: Factory ONE, Munich.

jobDescription.name: Apply
jobDescription.value:
• Resume: Show us things you have built, fixed or organized: projects, workshop or production experience, student teams, previous internships.
  • Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?
  • Practicalities: Tell us your preferred start date, your enrollment status and whether this is a mandatory internship.

jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value:
Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories: the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

At Factory ONE in Munich, metal laser powder bed fusion produces flight and defense hardware where one bad layer can scrap a part worth weeks of work. As our LPBF Technician, you own the metal printers end to end: from build preparation through powder, machine and post-processing to a part that is ready for inspection.

You make sure every metal build runs, and every part can be traced back to its powder lot.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
• Run the LPBF machines. Set up, monitor and shut down LPBF builds, including plate, recoater and inert gas.

  • Prepare builds. Check orientation, supports and plate layout, and tell engineering what will print reliably.

  • Own the powder. Sieving, storage and lot traceability, with strict safety discipline on reactive powders.

  • Post-process. Depowdering, stress relief, plate and support removal, and handover to machining and metrology.

  • Maintain. Filter changes, cleaning, preventive maintenance and first-level troubleshooting.

  • Recover from failures. Secure the data, find the cause, then restart.

  • Document. Build records and non-conformities per EN9100, traceable to every serial number.

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• 2+ years hands-on LPBF experience in an industrial environment, ideally aerospace, defense, medical or energy.
  • Machine fluency. You have run and maintained LPBF systems on your own (e.g. EOS, SLM/Nikon, Trumpf, Renishaw, Colibrium Additive). You know what a recoater crash, short feed or a rising oxygen level looks like and what to do about it.
  • Powder safety. You know how to handle reactive metal powders safely: inerting, grounding, ATEX awareness, wet separators, PPE.
  • Process understanding. You understand how orientation, supports and parameters affect distortion, porosity and surface quality.
  • Quality mindset. You document cleanly and treat traceability as part of the job. Experience in an EN9100 or ISO 13485 environment is a plus.
  • Hands-on. You depowder, clean, change filters and saw plates yourself.
  • Language: Fluent German for the shop floor, working English for the team in Zurich.
  • On-site: Based in Munich, working on site at Factory ONE.

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• Operators who press start and walk away. Each build gets your attention until the part is off the plate.
  • Anyone who restarts a crashed job without understanding the cause.
  • People who take shortcuts with powder safety or traceability.
  • Anyone who needs every procedure written out before acting. You help write them.

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your builds become mission-critical hardware.
  • Growth path: You work directly with our LPBF lead and grow with the metal AM floor, with the option to lead your own sub-team as it scales.
  • Ownership: You run the metal AM floor from day one and shape how it scales.
  • The Environment: A greenfield factory with metal AM, SLS, 5-axis CNC and in-house metrology, in a data-driven production environment.
  • The Team: Close collaboration with engineering, quality, software and robotics. "Special Forces" model: everyone ships, no politics, no bureaucracy.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary incl. share options.
  • Location: Factory ONE, Munich.

jobDescription.name: Apply
jobDescription.value:
• Resume: Show us the LPBF systems, materials and parts you have worked with.
  • Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? And describe a build that failed: what caused it, and what you changed afterwards.

position.name: Senior Full Stack Engineer

jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value:
Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads.

  • Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own.

  • Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts.

  • Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal.


Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems.

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend

  • Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Technologies we like: TypeScript, Python, React, PostgreSQL, AWS.

  • End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half."

  • Industrial Grit: Comfortable spending time on the shop floor in Germany to understand how work actually happens and how your software interacts with precision machinery.

  • Autonomy: You are comfortable with diving into new topics, coming up with solutions and driving their implementation

  • Bonus points: Knowledge of manufacturing and how factories operate, basic understanding of the Manufacturing Automation Pyramid

  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• Engineers who only work on frontend or only work on backend. You must be comfortable across the full stack.

  • People who need detailed specs before they start building. You'll work directly with users and define the solution yourself.

  • Developers who ship code and move on. You own the outcome — not just the PR.

  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of Europe. Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space

  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions, and have the authority to execute.

  • The Environment: You are building solutions to accelerate production in a 5,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial plastic and metal 3D printers. Your work affects production of physical parts from day one.

  • The Team: Growing team of experienced software engineers, who value an open feedback culture. You may (and are expected to) challenge the status quo, prior decisions and drive SAEKI’s way forward.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.

  • Location: Zurich HQ with occasional travel to Factory ONE in Munich, Germany

jobDescription.name: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world
jobDescription.value:
SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival.

We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies.

jobDescription.name: The Role
jobDescription.value:
You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will:
  • Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most
  • Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one
  • Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks
  • Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust
  • Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning
  • Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven

jobDescription.name: What We're Looking For
jobDescription.value:
• Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on
  • Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool
  • Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it
  • Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you
  • Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision
  • Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits
  • Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience
  • Language: English. German is a plus for shop-floor conversations.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at Zurich, Switzerland, with regular time on the shop floor at Factory ONE in Munich, Germany.

jobDescription.name: What we're not looking for
jobDescription.value:
• Researchers without a user: every model you build here has a factory user, or it is dropped
  • Someone who needs clean data, a platform and a team before they can ship
  • Someone who wants to manage first and build later: the lead role is earned by proven MVPs
  • Generic ERP, MES or QMS feature work, or machine interaction: other teams own these

jobDescription.name: What we offer
jobDescription.value:
• Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the free world. What your systems learn in Factory ONE, every next factory applies.
  • The Environment: A real factory as your lab, with direct access to the people who run it, and ownership of the core of SAEKI's value proposition from day one.
  • The Team: A small, generalist Manufacturing Intelligence team that ships, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ

jobDescription.name: Apply
jobDescription.value:
• Resume: Focus on systems you shipped that real users relied on, and what happened to them after launch.
  • Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?
